sources.snippet: Model — lil-lab/CoLMLM-360M-FW: the 360M SmolLM2-based Co-LMLM retriever trained on FineWeb-Edu (HF model repo: weights + tokenizer). Loaded with the standard HF loader; the fact special tokens (<FACT> etc.) are in the tokenizer.

sources.title: Co-LMLM/src/annotation/OVERVIEW.md at main · lil-lab/Co-LMLM
sources.snippet: Annotator Types gemini - only used for creating the seed dataset. MLM (masked language model) - BERT-style model that only predicts <FACT> and </FACT> tokens, annotating factual spans without generating questions. question hybrid - MLM generates spans, then the question generator prefills the context KV cache.

sources.title: Co-LMLM: Continuous-Query Limited Memory Language Models
sources.snippet: The fact span annotator is a masked language model that detects fact spans on the original text via BIO tagging, 222BIO stands for begin-inside-outside (Ramshaw and Marcus, 1995). built on a ModernBERT encoder (Warner et al., 2025).
